Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
hi there :)

i just want to ask a simple thing about kiss of ra :

as usual i like to make a small set up or scenario to illustrate my
question so here i start.

we are 4 players
i play a stealthy vote deck.
my grand prey plays a heavy intercept deck, but has a horrible handjam
since no one acts at stealth.
I call with Suhalia an inoccuous vote.
my prey tries to intercept me, but i play a superior forgotten labyrinth
to outstealth him.
My grandprey sees that 4 stealth action as a good opportunity to cycle a
lot of intercept cards. So He plays forced awakening with his Meshenka
and plays eagle sight.

-since i'm the acting player, can i interrupt him *before* he even plays
a single +intercept card to play kiss of ra on Meshenka ?

I guess yes, by card text on eagle sight and kiss of ra.

-Does Meshenka burn an additional blood for not having blocked
successfuly ? (forced awakening)

//card texts//
The Kiss of Ra
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 3 blood
Discipline: Fortitude
Only usable when a vampire who does not have Fortitude *attempts to
block this acting minion*.
[for] The block attempt is canceled, the blocking vampire burns 2 blood,
and the current action is ended (without combat).
[FOR] As above, and the blocking vampire goes into torpor.

Eagle's Sight
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Auspex
[aus] This reacting vampire gets +1 intercept.
[AUS] This reacting vampire *attempts to block the current action*,
ignoring the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking
actions.
